raw: “If you were shown a great heap of dolls, and were set upon them to pluck them to pieces and despoil them for your own advantage, you would pick out the richest and gayest.
en: If you were shown a great heap of dolls, and were set upon them to pluck them to pieces and despoil them for your own advantage, you would pick out the richest and gayest.
ko: 만약 너에게 인형 더미가 주어지고, 네 자신의 이익을 위해 그것들을 산산조각 내고 약탈하라고 한다면, 넌 가장 화려하고 예쁜 것을 고르겠지.

raw: But try!
en: But try!
ko: 하지만 시도하십시오!

raw: “I intend to try.
en: "I intend to try.
ko: “시도할 생각이네.

raw: True, but not an English woman.
en: Yes, but not to an English woman.
ko: 사실입니다만, 영국 여자와 한 것은 아닙니다.

raw: He professed himself more relieved and encouraged than he really was, and approached his second and last point.
en: He pretended to be more relieved and encouraged than he actually was, and moved on to his second and final point.
ko: 그는 실제보다 더 안심하고 용기를 얻은 척하며 두 번째이자 마지막 요점으로 넘어갔다.

raw: From the streets beyond the high wall and the strong gate, there came the usual night hum of the city, with now and then an indescribable ring in it, weird and unearthly, as if some unwonted sounds of a terrible nature were going up to Heaven.
en: Mr. Lorry clasped his hands and said, “Thank God that no one near and dear to me is in this dreadful town tonight.”
ko: Lorry(로리) 씨가 두 손을 깍지 끼고 말했습니다. “이 끔찍한 도시에 오늘 밤 나와 가깝고 소중한 사람이 아무도 없다니, 신께 감사합니다.”

raw: Mr. Lorry’s spirits grew heavier and heavier, as he and his two companions ascended higher and higher.
en: Mr. Lorry’s spirits grew heavier and heavier, as he and his two companions ascended higher and higher.
ko: 그와 두 동반자가 점점 더 높이 올라갈수록 로리 씨의 마음은 점점 더 무거워졌다.

raw: “That’s well.
en: "That's good.
ko: “잘 생각하셨습니다.

raw: Lorry immediately remembered, and regarded his new visitor with an undisguised look of abhorrence.
en: Lorry immediately remembered, and regarded his new visitor with an undisguised look of abhorrence.
ko: Lorry 씨는 즉시 기억해냈고, 감출 수 없는 혐오감 어린 표정으로 그의 새로운 방문객을 바라보았다.

raw: A crowbar?
en: A crowbar?
ko: 쇠지렛대인가?

raw: But it really is doubly and trebly hard to have crowds and multitudes of people turning up after him (I could have forgiven him), to take Ladybird’s affections away from me.”
en: But it really is doubly and trebly hard to have crowds and multitudes of people turning up after him (I could have forgiven him), to take Ladybird’s affections away from me.”
ko: 하지만 무당벌레의 애정을 내게서 뺏어가려고 (박사님이라면 내가 용서할 수 있었겠지만) 그분 뒤를 따라 떼를 지어 수많은 사람들이 몰려드는 건 정말이지 두 배, 세 배는 더 힘들다고요.”

raw: “Well then!
en: "Well then!
ko: "음, 그럼!

raw: Had he ever been a spy himself?
en: Had he ever been a spy himself?
ko: 그 자신이 스파이 노릇을 한 적이 있는지?

raw: “I do not understand the meaning of the term, but I have heard them say so.”
en: “To buy,” said the deceased toll-gatherer, as an aside to his toll-gathering wife.
ko: “살 거야,” 죽은 통행료 징수원이 곁에 있는 통행료 징수원 아내에게 방백(aside)처럼 말했다.

raw: Confused by the emotion of the day, and feeling his being there with this Double of coarse deportment, to be like a dream, Charles Darnay was at a loss how to answer;
en: Confused by the emotion of the day, and feeling his being there with this Double of coarse deportment to be like a dream, Charles Darnay was at a loss for how to answer;
ko: 오늘 하루의 감정들로 혼란스러운 데다 무례한 태도를 가진 이 분신과 함께 그곳에 있다는 사실이 마치 꿈처럼 느껴졌기 때문에, Charles Darnay는 어떻게 대답해야 할지 몰라 당황했다;

raw: the mail was waylaid by seven robbers, and the guard shot three dead, and then got shot dead himself by the other four, “in consequence of the failure of his ammunition:” after which the mail was robbed in peace;
en: The mail coach was ambushed by seven robbers. The guard shot three of them dead, but was then shot dead himself by the other four 'as a result of running out of ammunition.' After that, the mail was robbed in peace.
ko: 우편 마차는 일곱 명의 강도에게 매복 공격을 받았고, 경비원은 세 명을 쏴 죽인 후 '탄약이 바닥난 결과' 나머지 네 명에게 자신도 총에 맞아 죽었으며, 그 후 우편 마차는 평화롭게 약탈당했다.

raw: My old pain has given me a power that has brought us through the barrier, and gained us news of Charles there, and brought us here.
en: “Don’t look!” cried Mr. Lorry, absolutely desperate. “No, Lucie, my dear, nor you!”
ko: “보지 마세요!” Lorry(로리) 씨가 완전히 절망하며 소리쳤습니다. “안 됩니다, Lucie(루시), 얘야, 너도 안 돼!”

raw: “What is the meaning of One Hundred and Five, North Tower?” asked Defarge. “Quick!”
en: "What is the meaning of One Hundred and Five, North Tower?" asked Defarge. "Quick!"
ko: "북탑 105호가 무슨 뜻인가?" 드파르주가 물었다. "빨리 대답해!"

raw: He tried to prepare himself in vain;
en: He tried in vain to prepare himself;
ko: 그는 스스로 마음의 준비를 하려고 애썼지만 소용없었지.

raw: What a change you have made in yourself!
en: What a change you have made in yourself!
ko: 너 스스로를 얼마나 변하게 만들었는지 좀 봐!

raw: Whatever tools they worked with, they worked hard, until the awful striking of the church clock so terrified Young Jerry, that he made off, with his hair as stiff as his father’s.
en: Whatever tools they worked with, they worked hard, until the awful striking of the church clock so terrified Young Jerry, that he made off, with his hair as stiff as his father's.
ko: 어떤 도구로 작업을 하든, 그들은 교회 시계가 울리는 무시무시한 소리에 어린 제리가 너무 놀라 머리카락이 아버지처럼 뻣뻣해진 채 도망칠 때까지 열심히 일했다.

raw: Tellson and Co., Bankers, London, England.”
en: Tellson and Co., Bankers, London, England.'
ko: 텔슨 앤 코, 뱅커스, 런던, 잉글랜드."

raw: The man cries, “Down, Evrémonde!
en: The man cries, "Down with Evremonde!"
ko: 그 남자가 외친다, "에브레몽드 타도!"

raw: As everything turned upon her, and revolved about her, they went out under the plane-tree, and she carried the wine down for the special benefit of Mr. Lorry.
en: As everything turned upon her, and revolved about her, they went out under the plane-tree, and she carried the wine down for the special benefit of Mr. Lorry.
ko: 모든 것이 그녀를 중심으로 돌아갔기에 그들은 플라타너스 나무 아래로 나갔고, 그녀는 특별히 Lorry 씨를 위해 와인을 가지고 내려왔습니다.

raw: Mr. Lorry was already out when he got back, and it was easy to surmise where the good old man was gone.
en: Mr. Lorry was already out when he got back, and it was easy to surmise where the good old man was gone.
ko: 그가 돌아왔을 때 Lorry씨는 이미 외출하고 없었고, 이 선량한 노인이 어디로 갔는지는 짐작하기 쉬웠다.

raw: which was only after heavy rains, and then it ran, by many eccentric fits, into the houses.
en: which was only after heavy rains, and then it ran, by many eccentric fits, into the houses.
ko: 비가 많이 내린 후에야 비로소 흘렀고, 그때조차도 기이하고 변덕스럽게 집 안으로 흘러들어 가곤 했습니다.

raw: “Surely it will release him!” said Madame Defarge. “Let it do so.”
en: “Surely that will free him!” said Madame Defarge. “Let it do just that.”
ko: “분명 그 영향력이 그를 풀어주겠군!” Madame Defarge가 말했다. “어디 그렇게 되게 놔두지.”

raw: so many more will die of want.”
en: so many more will die of starvation.”
ko: 더 많은 이들이 굶주림으로 죽어갈 것입니다.”

raw: That, as they were not so decreed, he probably would not have one.
en: That, as they were not so decreed, he probably would not receive one.
ko: 그렇게 명해지지 않았으므로, 그는 아마도 동상을 얻지 못할 것이라는 것이다.

raw: I have gone aside from my purpose;
en: I have gone aside from my purpose;
ko: 제가 본론에서 벗어났군요;
